title: Coefficient and scalar-complex comparison for the canonical small integral ring
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension in any universe, $L$ its canonical small presentation, $R=\mathcal O_L^\uparrow$, and $I=(\pi_L^\uparrow)$ [def-sfb-integral-heart-local-model-data, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Write $B_X$ for its pulled-back continuous integral ring and $\widehat R_X=\varprojlim_{n\geq 1}(R/I^n)_X$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. There is an equivalence $F:\operatorname{Mod}_{\rm int}(B_X)\simeq\operatorname{Mod}(\widehat R_X)$ such that (i) an ordinary module $M$ has finite constant constructible local presentations [sk-def-sfb-constructible] if and only if $F(M)$ has completed constant stratified finitely presented models [def-sfb-completed-constant-stratified]; (ii) for every immersion $f:S\to X$, every object $U$ of $S_{\rm proet}$, every ordinary unbounded derived object $K$ over $B_X$, and every scalar cochain complex $P$ over $R$, the localized objects $F(K)$ and the completed constant realization of $P$ are isomorphic on the slice at $U$ if and only if $(U\to S\to X)^*K$ is isomorphic to the termwise integralHeartRealization of $P$ on $U.left$. Here $F(K)$ is termwise derived transport along the exact equivalence F, and the localization and completed realization are exactly sfbLocalRestriction and sfbCompletedModel [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data]. There is no boundedness, finiteness or projectivity condition on P, and no existence of local models or completion of K is asserted.

proof.text: For the canonical small field L, identify the continuous integer ring on the profinite point with the limit of its finite discrete positive uniformizer quotients. The finite functions sheaves are the constant quotient sheaves. Pull this projection-normalized comparison to X with the profinite coefficient inverse-image theorem. Apply sectionModuleEquivalence and restriction along the resulting ring-sheaf isomorphism to obtain an exact equivalence F of ordinary module categories. No derived object is completed.

proof.text: Identify finite presentations on the condensed point with cokernels of matrices over its terminal section ring, which is the lifted valuation ring R. Projection normalization takes every entry to its constant section in every quotient and hence in the completed ring. Exactness transports the matrix cokernels in both directions. The equivalence commutes with inverse image and slice restriction. Retain the finite constructible strata, pass between cover families and covering sieves, and use that Noetherian X is qcqs. This identifies IsConstantModelConstructible with IsCompletedConstantStratified.

source.place: Clause (1), coefficient and slice comparisons, part 2 of the detailed construction in IntegralHeartCompletedComparison.lean.

proof.text: For an immersion f:S to X and an object U of the pro-etale site of S, identify the slice at U with the pro-etale site of U.left. The exact equivalence induced by the same coefficient comparison identifies sfbLocalRestriction of F(K) with inverse image of K along U.hom followed by f. Its composite on completed constant scalar modules is integralHeartRealization, since both are sheafified tensor extension along the map sending each scalar to its constant continuous function. The comparison is natural in every scalar-linear map, so it identifies every scalar differential. Pass the exact equivalences and their natural isomorphisms to ordinary unbounded derived categories. They preserve and reflect the local isomorphisms in the statement for arbitrary K and P, without boundedness, projectivity or a local existence assertion.

theorem integralHeart_completed_comparison
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : Type v) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic ℓ) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic ℓ) E]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    let I : Ideal (integralHeartScalars.{u} ℓ E) :=
      Ideal.span {ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer ℓ
        (SmallAdicCompletion.Coefficients.field ℓ E))}
    ∃ F : SmallAdicCompletion.Modules ℓ E X ≌
        Scheme.proEtaleRingModules X (Scheme.adicLisseCompletedRing X I),
      letI : F.functor.Additive := Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products _
      (∀ M : SmallAdicCompletion.Modules ℓ E X,
        IsConstantModelConstructible
            (SmallAdicCompletion.Coefficients.integerRing ℓ E) X M ↔
          Scheme.IsCompletedConstantStratified X I (F.functor.obj M)) ∧
      ∀ (S : Scheme.{u}) (f : S ⟶ X) [IsImmersion f] (U : S.ProEt)
        (K : integralHeartDerivedCategory.{u} ℓ E X)
        (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (integralHeartScalars.{u} ℓ E)) ℤ),
        Nonempty (Scheme.sfbLocalRestriction f (Scheme.adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U
              (F.functor.mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≅
            Scheme.sfbLocalRestriction f (Scheme.adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U
              (Scheme.sfbCompletedModel X I P)) ↔
          Nonempty (((CondensedRing.upperStar
              (SmallAdicCompletion.Coefficients.integerRing ℓ E)
              (U.hom ≫ f)).mapDerivedCategory).obj K ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj
              (((integralHeartRealization.{u} ℓ E U.left).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).obj P))
